title: WebSocket Communication
definition: WebSockets upgrade an HTTP connection into a persistent TCP connection, allowing real-time, bidirectional, event-driven communication.
simpleExplanation: A dedicated phone line between the browser and the server that stays open 24/7.

answers.question: What is the main tradeoff of WebSockets?
answers.answer: Usually a tradeoff between Server CPU usage, TTFB (Time to First Byte), and Client CPU usage.
